items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: And we stood up there with men like Elma Chambers and Jimmy Harrison

ctx.x: And then, Jimmy Harrison was trombone. And then I had a fellow in there called Fats. I don't know what Fats' name was. He was a friend of Jimmy's. But, anyhow, Fats, we went out to, after the season was finished.
